summary: Phase 2.5C — Aba Financeiro do Paciente + Recibos PDF sequenciais (email + WhatsApp) — 26/26 backend pytest PASS, 2 skipped (finalize-attendance test payload mismatch, not a bug). Frontend UI validated via screenshot: aba Financeiro shows 4 KPIs (Total Pago, Pendente, Vencido, Próximo Vencimento), entries table with parcela metadata, overdue rows highlighted, Marcar pago + Recibo + Email + WhatsApp actions per row. Auto-generation of REC-2026-#### confirmed on POST (paid=true creation) and on PUT (paid=false→true transition). PDF download returns valid %PDF-1.4 bytes. WhatsApp wa.me link builds with BR country code auto-prefix + full receipt PDF URL. Email endpoint uses patient email by default + custom override. RBAC: admin/financeiro full, recepcao read-only, profissional 403. Non-destructive PUT preserves patient_id/budget_id/notes across paid toggle.
